newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS TERMINATES CONTRACT WITH MALJKOVIC.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS TERMINATES CONTRACT WITH MALJKOVIC.

text.p: European basketball champions Panathinaikos terminated on Sunday a $2-million contract with Serb coach Bozidar Maljkovic after a dismal season, club officials said.
"Our cooperation with Mr Maljkovic ended by mutual agreement. The name of the new coach will be announced in the very soon," a Panathinaikos official told Reuters.

Maljkovic, who led Panathinaikos to their first European crown last year, was blamed this season for replacing key players like NBA star Dominique Wilkins and Croat international pivot Stojan Vrankovic stripping the club of fire power.

Panathinaikos, the most expensive club in Europe, had their worst season in years with humiliating defeats to bitter rivals Olympiakos which left them out of a European Final Four for the first time in three years.
They also finished third in the Greek championship with Olympiakos, among the favourites in Rome's Final Four this month, finishing first in the regular season.
Their European prospects were trimmed further on Saturday with yet another defeat in the Greek Cup semifinal to Apollon, a small club from the western port of Patras.
"We still have a chance to win the Greek championship in the playoffs but the psychology of the team is bad," the official said.
Maljkovic, who has won four European crowns with Yugoplastika, Limoges and Panathinaikos, will probably sign with a French club next season.
"Maljkovic never fit in Panathinaikos. He kept at the bench or marginalised a number of excellent players. His own choices of players proved wrong," the official said.
Panathinaikos President Pavlos Yannakopoulos has spend a European record of $55 million in the past five years tp assemble a team of stars.
Club officials said he has offered French international power forward Antoine Rigodeau, now an Orthez player, $2 million dollars a year for a three-year contract, starting next season.
